fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 2012 Chevy Captiva SUV.
findings: Light-colored stains and lint across the rear bench seat cushion
Dust and debris in the front center console and cup holders
Hazy, yellowed headlight lenses on the front
Dusty, dull black paint on the hood and front bumper
Dust on the dashboard and door panel trim
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2012 Captiva. The rear bench has some light staining and the headlights look a bit hazy in the photos, both of which clean up well before a sale. We do pre-sale details, inside and out, and come to you. Would you like a quote?
